title: Capital Flows — X Money · Digital Credit ↔ Margin
notes: v39: reverse LE order to X Money → Digital Credit → Margin. Turo → X Money only. Lyft → both X Money and Digital Credit. Digital Credit ↔ Margin (replaces X Money ↔ Margin as the equities loop). X Money still funds Deploy and still two-way with Digital Credit (cash ↔ Morpho/BTC).

legend.observed: Seen in YNAB/Plaid or expense sheet

income_sources.label: Turo
income_sources.evidence: Turo payouts land X Money (ops cash sleeve).

income_sources.label: Lyft
income_sources.evidence: Lyft splits to both X Money (ops) and Digital Credit (Coinbase/Morpho engine).

income_sources.label: ASICs
income_sources.evidence: Braiins → Digital Credit (Coinbase) every other month.

channels.label: X Money
channels.subtitle: ~6% · ops float
channels.notes: Ops cash sleeve (left of LE). Receives Turo + half of Lyft; funds Deploy; two-way with Digital Credit (cash ↔ Morpho/BTC).

channels.label: Digital Credit
channels.subtitle: BTC · Morpho · USDC HY
channels.notes: Morpho engine mid-LE: liquidity → BTC spot; LTV cool → USDC HY; LTV hot → HY tops BTC. One Card refinance via Morpho. Two-way with X Money and with Margin.

channels.label: Margin
channels.subtitle: Agentic · stocks · USDG HY
channels.notes: RH equities engine: liquidity → stock spot; margin cool → USDG HY; heat → HY tops stock. Bidirectional with Digital Credit (not X Money). Optional extract is not income.

channels.label: Collateral
channels.subtitle: Agentic · BTC stack
channels.notes: Deploy sink for free dollars into investable collateral (Agentic / BTC) after Essential + Fleet, before discretionary.

edges.label: cash → DC engine
edges.notes: X Money funds Digital Credit (Coinbase / Morpho / BTC / USDC HY).

edges.label: borrow → cash
edges.notes: Morpho USDC (and ops surplus) into X Money cash sleeve.

edges.label: invest collateral
edges.notes: Free dollars into Agentic / BTC collateral after ops floors.

edges.label: → equities engine
edges.notes: Digital Credit funds / rebalances into Margin (RH Agentic · stocks · USDG). Replaces prior X Money → Margin auto as the DC–Margin spine.

edges.label: optional extract
edges.notes: Optional loop back Digital Credit ← Margin — NOT income. Dual-engine risk.
